related.title: 工業機器人安全工作站
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：深度與視差呈反比，遮蔽點未冒充量測，抓取可行性有獨立碰撞檢查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Depth varies inversely with disparity, occlusions are not called measurements, and grasp feasibility includes separate collision checks.
related.difference: 把感測延遲、處理延遲與停止距離分開，不把簡化課內距離視為合規防護距離。
related.differenceEn: Separate sensing/processing delay and stopping distance without treating the classroom sum as a compliant safeguard distance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 校正平行雙目Z=fB/d；小誤差uZ≈fB ud/d²，f與d同用像素。 教學f=800 px，基線B=0.10 m，視差d=40 px，視差標準不確定度0.5 px。 Z=800×0.10/40=2.0 m；uZ≈800×0.10×0.5/40²=0.025 m。
單一物體的簡化行進量d=vT+dstop+u；不包含人員接近速度、全身幾何或功能安全失效率。 離線合成v=0.2 m/s、總延遲T=0.10 s、已量得停止行程0.03 m、比較餘量0.02 m。 d=0.2×0.10+0.03+0.02=0.070 m。此值只能驗證課內時間帳。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For rectified stereo Z=fB/d and small-erroruZ≈fB ud/d², with f and d both in pixels. Teaching f 800 px, baseline 0.10 m, disparity 40 px and disparity uncertainty 0.5 px. Z=2.0 m; uZ≈0.025 m.

A single-object teaching sumd=vT+dstop+u excludes human approach, body geometry and functional-safety failure rates. Offline syntheticv 0.2 m/s, total latency 0.10 s, measured stopping travel 0.03 m and comparison allowance 0.02 m. d=0.070 m; this value verifies only the classroom time ledger.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 三次元量床校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：深度與視差呈反比，遮蔽點未冒充量測，抓取可行性有獨立碰撞檢查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Depth varies inversely with disparity, occlusions are not called measurements, and grasp feasibility includes separate collision checks.
related.difference: 分清溫度修正值與修正後不確定度，避免認為軟體補償會消除所有熱誤差。
related.differenceEn: Separate temperature correction from residual uncertainty rather than assuming software removes all thermal error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 校正平行雙目Z=fB/d；小誤差uZ≈fB ud/d²，f與d同用像素。 教學f=800 px，基線B=0.10 m，視差d=40 px，視差標準不確定度0.5 px。 Z=800×0.10/40=2.0 m；uZ≈800×0.10×0.5/40²=0.025 m。
均溫細長件L(T)=Lref[1+αΔT]；溫度梯度、夾持與機台幾何誤差不包含在此式。 教學Lref=500 mm，α=11.5×10^−6/K，ΔT=3 K，參考溫度僅作課內基準。 ΔL=500×11.5×10^−6×3=0.01725 mm；熱態長500.01725 mm，反算應除以1.0000345。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For rectified stereo Z=fB/d and small-erroruZ≈fB ud/d², with f and d both in pixels. Teaching f 800 px, baseline 0.10 m, disparity 40 px and disparity uncertainty 0.5 px. Z=2.0 m; uZ≈0.025 m.

For a uniform-temperature slender part, L(T)=Lref[1+αΔT]; gradients, fixturing and machine geometry are excluded. Teaching reference length 500 mm,α11.5×10^−6/K,ΔT 3 K, with an explicitly chosen classroom reference temperature. ΔL=0.01725 mm; hot length 500.01725 mm, inverted by dividing by 1.0000345.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
